chips.title: Select a real intervention case
chips.summary: Pick one repository where an audit finding should change agent behavior, record the before state, and define what an improvement would look like.

evidence.message: Named as the next step by the 2026-09-05 status reassessment; nothing started yet.
Started 2026-09-09: running static and behavior audits to pick the case.
Done 2026-09-09: chose the start-of-turn approval gate; before state and improvement measures recorded in the case record.
Verified the prerequisite and stored tool counts; corrected the baseline timing and evidence limits; clarified improvement and safety measures.

chips.title: Prove the intervention changed behavior
chips.summary: Show the applied change moved the measured behavior, not only the report; decide whether findings need a stronger effect signal.

evidence.message: Follows the intervention case; shape depends on what that case shows.
Unblocked 2026-09-09: apply one narrow gate rule change, then re-measure I1-I4 and safety S1-S2 from the case record.
Blocked 2026-09-09: apu-wtf selector fix landed and a restore point exists, but the harness classifier denies edits to the gate hook; operator must apply the packaged script.
Attempt 1 failed: the applied gate change crashed after approvals, so halts no longer withdrew approval. Script fixed and tested; operator must reapply and rerun the proof.
Voice listener side note: it pastes a leading space, which defeats the CLI bang prefix for shell commands. Fix later in the listener.
Done 2026-09-09: corrected gate change proven on the live hook. I1 and I2 met, S1 and S2 hold at hook level; I3 needs a gate-decision log and audit detector, I4 not targeted.

chips.title: Measure gate cost from decisions, not reports
chips.summary: Make I3 measurable: a content-free gate decision log per prompt, and a bounded-audit detector joining read-only turns to those decisions.

evidence.message: Scoped by the case record decision on the effect signal. The hook-side log needs operator authorization; the APU detector can be built against a fixed format.
Producer packaged: the hook logs one content-free gate line per state write. Reapply needed; the audit detector that reads it is still to build.

chips.title: Resolve the gate rule gaps
chips.summary: Decide and, if authorized, narrow the steer-word carry-forward and the mid-sentence halt over-match; apply the note-write exemption for I4.

evidence.message: Blocked on an operator decision: whether a steer-led new objective may inherit approval. Halt over-match predates the change; I4 exemption never applied.
Operator decided 2026-09-09: steer-led new objectives do not inherit approval. Packaged and tested; reapply pending. Halt over-match and I4 still open.
Durable path built: the script renders an approved APU plan; apu apply is now provider-neutral. Operator must run the apply; the harness denies it to the session.
